# Kermetico HVAF and HVOF Thermal  Spray Coating Equipment and Technology*

We design, manufacture and optimize HVAF and HVOF [thermal spray][81] coating equipment and utilize
this emerging technology in our spray [shop][82] to provide coating services in Benicia, California,
USA. We [spray][83] real-world jobs every day, and use this experience to constantly improve our
torches and systems to more effectively and efficiently produce coatings to meet and exceed our
customers most stringent requirements.  Everything we have in our product line has evolved or in
some way been improved by our spray work, this coating service is our real-world R&D lab.

**Gas Fuel Thermal Spray Systems**

**Kermetico**, Inc. manufactures HVAF and HVOF systems that are capable of operating a range of high
velocity spray guns for the efficient deposition of cemented [carbide ][84]and [metal ][85]coatings.

The coatings deposited with our **Kermetico** systems exhibit high density and hardness, combined
with excellent ductility, which results in best in market [wear ][86]and [cavitation ][87]resistance
of our impermeable, [corrosion-resistant][88] layers.

This high quality comes with the additional benefit of lower cost per unit of coating due to the
efficient use of energy which is unique to **Kermetico**, and which results in deposition rates four
to eight times higher than conventional HVOF.

We design, manufacture and optimize HVAF and HVOF [thermal spray][81] coating equipment and utilize
this emerging technology in our spray [shop][82] to provide coating services in Benicia, California,
USA. We [spray][83] real-world jobs every day, and use this experience to constantly improve our
torches and systems to more effectively and efficiently produce coatings to meet and exceed our
customers most stringent requirements.  Everything we have in our product line has evolved or in
some way been improved by our spray work, this coating service is our real-world R&D lab.

**Gas Fuel Thermal Spray Systems**

**Kermetico**, Inc. manufactures HVAF and HVOF systems that are capable of operating a range of high
velocity spray guns for the efficient deposition of cemented [carbide ][84]and [metal ][85]coatings.

The coatings deposited with our **Kermetico** systems exhibit high density and hardness, combined
with excellent ductility, which results in best in market [wear ][86]and [cavitation ][87]resistance
of our impermeable, [corrosion-resistant][88] layers.

This high quality comes with the additional benefit of lower cost per unit of coating due to the
efficient use of energy which is unique to **Kermetico**, and which results in deposition rates four
to eight times higher than conventional HVOF.

The unique combination of high quality and low coating cost  also benefits from equipment that is
user friendly, and proven and improved on a daily basis in our northern California spray shop.

* [AK5][100] – a compact gun to spray internal diameters/bores 200 mm (8″) and larger

# KL Coatings

Your Partner in Surface Engineering Solutions


ISO9001:2015 | AS9100D | NADCAP | FAA Repair Station (Approval Pending)

KL Coatings, Inc. is best known as a thermal spray coatings house that has branched out to be so
much more.  From protective thermal spray coatings and powder coatings to machining, production
assembly, we strive to be an engineering solutions provider.  We concentrate on efficient and lean
operations, which allow us to be competitive in price and turnaround time.

### Coating Technologies
* Atmospheric Plasma Spray (APS)
* High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF)
* Wire Arc Spray
* Plasma Electrolytic Oxidation
* Boronizing
* Low Pressure Plasma Spray (LPPS)
* Powder Coating
* Specialty Painting (MIL-C-81751)

### Coating Materials
* Tungsten Carbide Variations
* Chrome Carbide Variations
* MCrAlY Coatings
* Thermal Barrier Coatings
* Chrome Oxide
* Aluminum Oxide
* Aluminum Bronze
* Metallic Coatings
* T-400 and T-800 Coatings
* Customer Specific Coatings
* MIL-C-81751 Metallic Ceramic Coatings

### Engineered coating solutions available for:
* Temperature Gradient Management
* Heat Protection
* Corrosion Resistance
* Oxidation Resistance
* Wear Resistance
* Abrasion Resistance
* High/Low Electric Conductivity
* High/Low Thermal Conductivity
* High/Low Friction
* Dimensional Restoration
* Dielectric Strength
* EMI/RFI Shielding

# Thermal Arc Spray Systems
# & Coatings From Thermion

the most reliable high production metalizing systems in the world

With a focus to supply the coatings industry with the most productive and reliable thermal arc spray
system used in metalizing, Thermion® is your direct source for High Production metalizing systems,
materials and other accessories used in arc spray or metalizing.

[view our equipment][100] [View our wires][101]
[View Our Video][102]
What We Have

## Explore Our Products

Thermion® is the manufacturer of Twin Wire [Arc Spray Equipment][103] used in applying thermal
sprayed coatings. These metalized coatings are sometimes referred to as thermal spray, arc
spray, [metalizing][104], twin wire arc spray, [custom spray systems,][105] TSA or even TSZ; in
essence, we can spray all conductive metals in wire form.

Thermion® Metalizing equipment is used worldwide to apply long life, cost effective coatings used
for [anti-corrosion][106], anti-wear, anti-abrasion, repair, remanufacturing and non-skid to name a
few. Our founder, Frank Rogers, who is still active in Thermion®, invented the first Thermion® spray
system back in the 1980s. Then, Thermion® metalizers featured the patented "Arc Shorting Control"
feature. Thermion® has since introduced its latest invention, "Arc Voltage Drive". Coupling the two
technologies has allowed Thermion® to become recognized as the most reliable high production
metalizing systems in the world.

Enhance the properties of parts by working with RTG. Backed by over 50 years of experience, our     
company utilizes the latest computer technology and old-fashioned craftsmanship to handle the entire
process of producing a complete part. From pre-machining and preparation to thermal spray coatings  
and finish machining, we have the capabilities to create a part for you. However, if you'd like, you
can send it to us, as well. RTG also specializes in overhauling and repairing parts to make them    
better or as good as new. Call us today to get started.

then, we have stayed in the forefront of the latest proven technologies to meet the highly stringent

# Advanced tungsten carbide engineering, hard material innovations and precision tool solutions for
# global industrial applications

## **Our Solutions**

For over 100 years, we have been developing and producing sophisticated cutting tools and hard
material solutions: From highly specialized [cutting tools][8], indexable inserts and [carbide
rods][9] to new types of carbide and cermet grades for [wear protection][10] as well as wood and
stone working.

Through constant innovation, introspection and ingenuity we blaze the path to unrivalled quality,
only matched by our passion for 360° service and loyal, long-lasting partnerships.

[Read more][11]

## Know Your Product Carbon Footprint

Our goal is to establish a common standard on the market for calculating and classifying the carbon
footprint of cutting tools, hard material solutions and tungsten carbide powders. In this way, we
will be able to provide customers the carbon footprint transparency they require.

[Read more][12]

## Career at CERATIZIT

**Are you looking for a career that lets you build on your strengths?**

As one of the world's leading companies in carbide solutions and precision tools, we offer you a
diverse environment in which you and your passion for the industry can thrive.

[Read more][13]

## Corporate Culture and Values

At CERATIZIT, people come first. Guided by our values and driven by creativity, collaboration, and
integrity, we empower employees to innovate, share ideas, and shape a sustainable future together.
Join a culture where diversity thrives, decisions are fast, and passion fuels progress.

[Read more][14]

## Passion for Cemented Carbide

**Cemented carbide from CERATIZIT for high wear demands**

CERATIZIT manages the entire production process chain of cemented carbide and cemented carbide
components, from powder preparation to forming, sintering, finishing and surface treatment. The
blanks are subjected to grinding, polishing and EDM machining and are then given an innovative
wear-resistant coating, when necessary. This ensures that our carbide products have the properties
required for industrial applications.

[Read more][15]

**Are you looking for a career that lets you build on your strengths?**

As one of the world's leading companies in carbide solutions and precision tools, we offer you a

## Corporate Culture and Values

At CERATIZIT, people come first. Guided by our values and driven by creativity, collaboration, and

## Passion for Cemented Carbide

**Cemented carbide from CERATIZIT for high wear demands**

CERATIZIT manages the entire production process chain of cemented carbide and cemented carbide
components, from powder preparation to forming, sintering, finishing and surface treatment. The
blanks are subjected to grinding, polishing and EDM machining and are then given an innovative
wear-resistant coating, when necessary. This ensures that our carbide products have the properties
required for industrial applications.

# H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders:
# Unser Know-how für Ihren Erfolg

Wir sind H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders, ein Unternehmen der Mitsubishi Materials Corporation. Seit
mehr als 100 Jahren entwickeln und produzieren wir für unsere Kunden hochwertige Pulver aus dem
Refraktärmetall Wolfram und dessen Verbindungen. Unser Produktspektrum reicht von Wolframaten bis zu
Wolframcarbiden in ultrafeinen bis groben Korngrößen. Sie alle entsprechen höchsten Ansprüchen an
Qualität und Leistungsfähigkeit. Dank der umfassenden Kompetenz unserer Teams in Chemie und
Metallurgie beschreiten wir auch innovative Wege, um für Sie die Lösung mit optimalem Mehrwert zu
entwickeln. Das heißt für unsere Kunden: Sie erhalten exakt das Pulver, das ihren individuellen
Anforderungen entspricht.

## Wir sind H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders

[DE innovativ] Innovativ Wir verbinden Erfahrung mit Innovationsgeist. Hochqualifizierte Teams in
Forschung & Entwicklung und in der Anwendungstechnik widmen sich den Lösungen von morgen. So
entwickeln wir in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden maßgeschneiderte Lösungen mit
herausragenden Materialeigenschaften. Nachhaltig Verlässlich [DE nachhaltig] Innovativ Nachhaltig
Verlässlich Nachhaltigkeit ist ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmensstrategie. Mithilfe einer
eigenen Technologie gewinnen wir den Großteil unseres Rohstoffs durch Recycling. Ergänzend dazu
haben wir über unseren Eigentümer Masan High-Tech Materials Zugriff auf konfliktfreien
Primärrohstoff. Die laufende Optimierung von Prozessen und Verfahren trägt dazu bei, den Verbrauch
von Energie und Hilfsstoffen zu optimieren.
Seit 2023 ist unser deutscher Standort nach EMAS zertifiziert. [DE verlässlich] Innovativ Nachhaltig
Verlässlich Versorgungssicherheit ist für unsere Kunden ein zentrales Thema. Wir haben Zugang zu
Primär- und Sekundärrohstoffen und sind damit unabhängig von Quellen beispielsweise in China.
Das macht uns zu einem verlässlichen Partner.

## Unsere Produkte für Ihre Branche

Wolfram ist dank seiner besonderen Eigenschaften in vielen Schlüsselindustrien unverzichtbar.
Verschaffen Sie sich einen Überblick der Branchen, in denen hochwertige, individuelle Wolframpulver
von H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders zur Anwendung kommen.

### [Maschinen- und Werkzeugbau][35]

Hochleistungswerkzeuge sind aus dem Maschinenbau nicht wegzudenken. Die kontinuierliche Steigerung
ihrer Präzision, in Kombination mit erhöhter Lebensdauer, ermöglicht den Anwendern ein optimiertes
Arbeiten. H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders liefert die dazu notwendigen hochreinen und
anwendungsspezifischen Wolframcarbidpulver.

[Icon | Maschinenbau | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Automobilindustrie][36]

Die Fertigungstechnologien im modernen Automobilbau erfordern hochleistungsfähige
Hartmetallwerkzeuge – beispielsweise für die Bearbeitung von Motorblöcken oder Bremsen. Unsere
hochwertigen Wolframcarbidpulver eignen sich optimal für die Herstellung von Werkzeugen zum Spanen,
Umformen und für die Metallbearbeitung allgemein.

[Icon | Automobilindustrie | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Luftfahrt][37]

Ausgerechnet in der Luftfahrt, wo sich alles um Leichtbau dreht, kommt eines der schwersten Metalle
überhaupt zum Einsatz: Wolfram oder Wolframlegierungen werden hier wegen ihrer hohen Dichte und
Festigkeit in Ausgleichsgewichten, Vibrationsschutzteilen für Ladeklappen oder zum Ausbalancieren
von Rotorblättern eingesetzt.

[Icon | Luft- und Raumfahrt | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Öl- und Gasbranche][38]

### [Öl- und Gasbranche][38]

H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders entwickelt und produziert Wolframpulver speziell für den Einsatz in der
Öl- und Gasexploration. Das Technologiemetall kommt nicht nur in Hochleistungsbohrköpfen zum
Einsatz, sondern auch in Hohlladungen, die das Gestein rund um ein Bohrloch perforieren, damit Öl
und Gas abfließen können.

[Icon | Öl- und Gasexploration | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Chemische Industrie][39]

In der chemischen Industrie gibt es vielfältige Möglichkeiten Wolfram anzuwenden, insbesondere im
Bereich der Katalysatoren, wie zum Beispiel Oxidationskatalysatoren. Und wir verstehen es, die
passenden Wolframchemikalien herzustellen.

[Icon | Chemische Industrie | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Medizintechnik][40]

Die Medizintechnik nutzt Wolfram, um Geräte leistungsfähiger und schonender zu machen.
Präzisionsbauteile aus Wolframmetall werden beispielsweise in der modernen Röntgendiagnostik und
-therapie eingesetzt, um harte Röntgen- oder Gammastrahlung abzuschirmen und zu fokussieren.

[Medizintechnik | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Elektroindustrie][41]

Eine hohe thermische Belastbarkeit von Wolfram-Kupfer-Werkstoffen in Kombination mit sehr guten
Wärme- und guten elektrischen Leitfähigkeiten prädestinieren diese Materialien für Anwendungen in
elektrischen Hochleistungsschaltkontakten, als Wärmesenken in der Elektroindustrie oder zum Einsatz
als Erodierelektroden.

[Icon | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

Wir verarbeiten wolframhaltige Recyclingmaterialien zu hochleistungsfähigen Wolframverbindungen und
-metall. Darüber hinaus bieten wir Tantal- und Niobcarbidpulver an. Auch für Sie entwickeln wir die
optimale Pulvermischung – sprechen Sie uns an!

# Global leader in surface technologies & advanced materials

At Oerlikon, we engineer innovative technologies and solutions that make our customers' products
last longer, perform better, and generate less waste. Our high-tech surface solutions and advanced
materials are designed for applications in the most demanding industries.
About us
We make products better with our integrated offering of advanced materials, coating equipment and
services, and component manufacturing. Our global network of highly skilled engineers and problem
solvers is combined with a strong local presence, ensuring we are always close to our customers.

Oerlikon at the bottom of the sea

Oerlikon makes metals ready for the deep sea: coatings and materials protect drill bits, valves,
pumps and seals against pressure, corrosion and wear. This increases reliability, lowers costs and
helps protect sensitive underwater environments.

Taking off safely and efficiently

From turbines to landing gear, Oerlikon technologies help make aircraft safer, more efficient and
more economical. Our coatings, superalloy components and 3D printed parts protect metal alloys
against extreme heat and loads, supporting the next generation of sustainable aviation.

[ Read the full story ][93]
3
High performance for high performance

Semiconductors power everything from smartphones to cars and AI data centers. Oerlikon supports the
industry with coatings, thermal interface materials and 3D printed components that protect chip
production equipment, improve heat management and help manufacturers push the limits of performance.

[ Read the full story ][94]
4
Sustainable, durable and safe mobility

Oerlikon supports the automotive industry with solutions that make mobility safer and more
sustainable. Our technologies protect battery systems, reduce weight, lower friction and improve
manufacturing efficiency, helping both drivers and manufacturers.

faster. The technologies improve quality of life for millions of patients worldwide.

# Hannecard - ASB: Innovative Industrial Coating Services

Our coating services can dramatically improve your equipment’s performance and extend its working
life. We offer turnkey thermal spray and cold spray coatings, as well as secondary services like
welding, machining, and grinding, to give our customers finished, ready-to-use treated parts.

With decades of experience in identifying the causes of wear, we can adapt our thermal spray and
cold spray surfacing technologies to best address the needs of your application.

## First-Class Industrial Coating Services

With advanced equipment, a skilled staff of thermal sprayers and machinists, and extensive machining
and grinding capabilities, Hannecard - ASB can provide unique **[thermal spray][79]** and **[cold
spray][80]** solutions for extreme wear, high-temperature barriers, and all-encompassing part
repair.

Our in-house, turnkey industrial coating services will give your equipment extended service life by
meeting or exceeding original equipment designs. **[Submit your project][81]** or **[contact
us][82]** today!

## The Thermal Spray & Cold Spray Experts

Our [industrial coating services][83] are ideal for a broad range of applications in almost every
industry. We work hard to create customized thermal spray and cold spray solutions for your unique
challenges. Our thermal spray/cold spray [capabilities][84] include:
* [HVOF Coatings][85]
* [Flame Spray Coatings][86]
* [Hard Coating Surfacing][87]
* [Roll Coatings][88]
* [Plasma Electric Arc Spray][89]
* [Plasma Transferred Arc Welding][90]
* [Electric Arc Spray][91]

Because our industrial coating services are custom specified to your project, you can count on
superior protection for and exceptional performance from your coated components. We will work with
you to develop and outline procedures to match your defined specifications.

## Multimetal, now MM1018 - the first metal-polymer with building authority approval

Multimetal, our “liquid backing plate”, comes with polymer bonding which totallytransforms gap
compensation. This ensures your assembly process becomes quicker and safer, while also reducing
costs!

When you’re working on complex activities such as constructing a bridge or even a wind power plant,
multimetal is appropriate to use as it makes sure unevenness and imperfect flange connections are
taken care of.

There are a number of other advantages of using the tried-and-tested multimetal MM1018. It not only
helps save time and expenses, it is resistant to weather changes and chemical spillage. It is also
resistant to any pressure put on it and can become fully resilient in short period of time. It also
comes with general building authority approval.

## Seal and seal microporous metal with capillary action? seal!

When coatings are being treated using thermal spraying in a capillary-active manner, there are
always cracks, which need to be sealed. We manufacture dichtol, which is a 1-component polymer
system, to make sure metal can be sealed reliably. You can use dichtol for any kind of pores,
ranging from the smallest to the largest.

However, dichtol need not be used only in case of a crack. Instead, you can even use it as a
preventative measure. dichtol can permeate even the tiniest metal opening, so you can use it as
sealant without having to resort to mechanical or thermal stress.

## RMS Acquires Fusion, Inc. Expanding its Service Offering to include Precision Grinding, Laser
## Cladding & Thermal Spray Coatings

Rotating Machinery Services (RMS), a premier provider of aftermarket solutions for critical rotating
equipment, is excited to announce the acquisition of Fusion Inc., a Houston-based precision grinding
and thermal spray coating company specializing in tight-tolerance grinding, CNC and manual
machining, laser cladding, and wear-resistant coating applications.

This acquisition significantly expands RMS’s vertically integrated manufacturing capabilities,
enhancing its ability to control quality, cost, and lead time across the full lifecycle of
turbomachinery overhauls. Fusion’s in-house expertise will immediately support RMS’s overhaul and
repair of steam turbines, expanders, compressors, and other high-performance rotating equipment.

# A Lifetime Of Experience in Protective Coatings Your Trusted Coating Specialist in Pearland, TX

With decades of experience, Gartner Coatings is an established leader in industrial and
architectural coatings, proudly serving the Houston area. As protective coatings specialists, we
provide high-quality solutions for metal, aluminum, and industrial surfaces, ensuring superior
corrosion resistance and durability. Whether you need Valspar Industrial Coatings, metalized
coatings, or specialized coatings, we tailor our services to meet your needs.

## Comprehensive Coating Solutions

At Gartner Coatings, we deliver industrial coatings solutions that meet and exceed customer
expectations. Our team is highly trained and equipped with state-of-the-art technology to provide
high-performance coatings across various industries. As coating specialists, we strive to be the
trusted partner for businesses needing metalizing solutions, architectural aluminum, tank lining
solutions, and custom coatings.

### Metalizing Services

As a premier metalized coatings company, we provide thermal spray coating services engineered for
long-term corrosion protection. Our industrial coating specialists use twin arc spray and flame
spray coating methods to coat steel, aluminum, and concrete structures, including valves, heat
exchangers, process vessels, and ISO tanks. These processes enhance surface protection against
moisture, chemicals, and extreme environments.

[Learn More][3]

### Architectural Coatings

Gartner Coatings offers a full range of aluminum finishing services, each formulated with 70% Kynar
resin for unmatched weather resistance. As a certified applicator of Valspar Industrial Coatings on
architectural aluminum, we provide in-house color-matching services to improve lead time, and they
meet AAMA 2603 and AAMA 2605 standards. These architectural coatings resist dirt pickup, chalking,
fading and UV degradation.

[Learn More][4]

### Tank Lining & Coating Services

With over 75 years of expertise, Gartner Coatings is the protective coating specialist you can trust
for specialized tank lining services. As the leader in coating ISO tank containers and OTR trailers
for chemical and food-grade services, we provide the right lining on time, every time.

[Learn More][5]

### Other Services

Beyond corrosion protection, Gartner Coatings offers specialty coatings, liquid coatings, and
blasting services for various applications.

[Learn More][6]

At Gartner Coatings, we deliver industrial coatings solutions that meet and exceed customer
expectations. Our team is highly trained and equipped with state-of-the-art technology to provide
high-performance coatings across various industries. As coating specialists, we strive to be the

long-term corrosion protection. Our industrial coating specialists use twin arc spray and flame
spray coating methods to coat steel, aluminum, and concrete structures, including valves, heat
exchangers, process vessels, and ISO tanks. These processes enhance surface protection against
moisture, chemicals, and extreme environments.

resin for unmatched weather resistance. As a certified applicator of Valspar Industrial Coatings on
architectural aluminum, we provide in-house color-matching services to improve lead time, and they
meet AAMA 2603 and AAMA 2605 standards. These architectural coatings resist dirt pickup, chalking,
fading and UV degradation.

and price. As a national key Hi-Tech enterprise, the mission of XTC is to develop and expand Chinese
tungsten industry and new energy materials industry.

# Longevity Coatings Corp

## **Bringing New Efficiencies to Today’s Thermal Spray Coatings Industry.**

## **We specialize in coatings**

Carbides, metals, ceramics, and abradable thermal spray coatings, as well as dimensional restoration
coatings. No job is too small, too large or too complex. Longevity has the [materials][39] and
coating application process that will meet your needs in the most cost-effective way.

[Tungsten Carbide Coatings][40]
[Oxide Ceramic Coatings][41]
[Dimensional restoration][42]

## **THERMAL SPRAY COATING SERVICES**

Carbide, ceramic, and many other materials to industrial parts and products. Utilizing processes
including HVAF, HVOF, Plasma, twin wire arc and diffusion bonding. Learn More at the process pages
below.

[HVOF coatings][43]
[HVAF coatings][44]
[Plasma coatings][45]
[Twin arc coatings][46]
[Fused coatings][47]

### **What thermal spray coatings can do for you**
* **Enhance Durability:** Protect surfaces from wear, abrasion, and corrosion, extending component
  lifespan.
* **Improve Performance:** Optimize thermal, electrical, or chemical resistance for demanding
  applications.
* **Reduce Maintenance Costs:** Minimize downtime and repair expenses with robust, long-lasting
  coatings.
* **Increase Efficiency:** Enhance surface properties like lubricity or heat resistance to boost
  operational efficiency.
* **Enable Customization:** Tailor coatings to specific needs, such as high-temperature or non-stick
  properties.
* **Protect Against Harsh Environments:** Shield components from extreme temperatures, chemicals, or
  erosion.
* **Restore Worn Parts:** Rebuild and repair damaged surfaces, saving on replacement costs.

## **FULL-SERVICE MANUFACTURING/MACHINING**

Manufacturing of complete components, including CNC milling, turning, diamond grinding, Lapping and
solid ceramic, and carbide structures. Longevity coatings offers one stop manufacturing for
components that require spray coatings and final machining.

[Manufacturing Capabilities][48]

## Why Choose Longevity Coatings

Longevity Coatings has for decades provided quality thermal spray coatings to industry. With
industry knowledge dating back generations, We pride ourselves on producing the best possible spray
coating solution every time. Longevity has the equipment, knowledge, and facilities to provide the
best in surface coating solutions.

#### We can provide
* **Unmatched Expertise:** Decades of experience delivering precision thermal spray coatings for
  diverse industries.
* **Superior Quality:** Advanced coating technologies ensure exceptional durability, performance,
  and reliability.
* **Customized Solutions:** Tailored coatings to meet your specific needs, from wear resistance to
  thermal protection.
* **Cutting-Edge Technology:** State-of-the-art equipment and processes for consistent, high-quality
  results.
* **Fast Turnaround:** Efficient processes to minimize downtime and keep your operations running
  smoothly.

# A Trusted Provider of Thermal Spray Products and More

If you need it for your Thermal Spray Coating business, we’ve got it. For more than a decade
McLaughlin & Associates has provided quality products and services for all aspects of the thermal
spray coatings industry.

## We Help Your

## Business Succeed.

McLaughlin & Associates is committed to providing customers with affordable and dependable thermal
spray solutions to solve and exceed expectations. We're industry experts on thermal spray products,
machinery, systems, and consumables, including powder, wire, and more. But it doesn't stop there; we
are committed to helping you along the way. We provide expert consulting to ensure you find the
right products and services. We work hard to help you create a distinct performance advantage with
exceptional value in all we do!

We’re not only in the business of providing products and services; we’re in the business of solving

needs. Over the years, we have found that the perfect solutions come through intentional
conversations which uncover key challenges and opportunities, critical thinking, creativity, and a
commitment to success. Our goal is to be a trusted advisor.

aerospace and industrial applications, **with detailed attention to customer specifications,
accuracy and consistent quality.**

][65]

compression-style fittings maintain smooth internal bore transitions, reduce turbulence, and
minimize contamination risk. While quick-connect fittings may be acceptable for non-critical air
lines, they do not belong in precision powder carrier or delivery circuits.

compression-style fittings maintain smooth internal bore transitions, reduce turbulence, and
minimize contamination risk. While quick-connect fittings may be acceptable for non-critical air
lines, they do not belong in precision powder carrier or delivery circuits.

sprayed coatings. These metalized coatings are sometimes referred to as thermal spray, arc
spray, [metalizing][104], twin wire arc spray, [custom spray systems,][105] TSA or even TSZ; in

high-performance coatings for various products and equipment. Numerous industries rely on our
services to ensure optimal performance and better protection, providing the fastest turn-around
through our extensive manufacturing process.

surface. Vivid offers various methods such as Plasma spray, Twin Wire Arc, Cold spray, and Flame
Spray.

We have a variety of thermal spray solutions for every application. These are environmentally
friendly and an excellent alternative for those who want to cut costs for large production runs. We
can keep up with your demands using state-of-the-art technology while delivering consistent results
each time.

Our range of thermal spray applications:
* **Plasma spray coating**: The most popular form of thermal spray application is plasma spray
  coating. It’s versatile and primarily used in demanding industries due to its wide array of
  coating materials including ceramic coats. A semi-molten powder coat material is sprayed onto a
  surface for coating.
* **Twin arc spray**: We specialize in twin arc spray coating, where a thermal metal coating spray
  material is deposited on parts susceptible to corrosion and erosion. We use automated spray
  equipment to produce this layer of protection, increasing a product’s lifespan while protecting
  its components.
* **Cold spray**: Also known as supersonic particle deposition, this high-energy metal coating spray
  solution uses a heated high-pressure carrier gas to deposit or accelerate metal powders through a
  supersonic nozzle to facilitate particle adhesion.
* **Flame spray**: Using a heat source to melt powder or wire form into a sprayable coating, flame
  spray can metalize a substrate for superior protection on surfaces against innumerable
  environmental conditions while reducing the need for constant maintenance.

are used for high levels of protection and performance. These are primarily utilized for EMI
shielding, protection against abrasion issues, cosmetic appearance, and diverse thermal conductivity
applications.

  coatings are applied on the plastic substrate using air atomizing equipment or thermal coating
  systems.

ABOUT US

Luoyang Golden Egret Geotools Co., Ltd.

Luoyang Golden Egret Geotools Co., Ltd. is a global leading hard facing materials manufacturer which
supplies various surfacing materials include thermal spray powders, thermal [Spray Wires][75], laser
cladding powders, PTA welding powders, tungsten carbide welding rods and ropes. Products have been
delivered to more than thirty countries, and we keep a strategic & long-term partnership with some
famous enterprises in Europe and United States through OEM business. Luoyang Golden Egret
manufactures materials serve industries such as oil & gas, steel, pape, plastic, power generation,
aviation, and mining etc. Stable & premium quality, in-time customer service, and best technical
support are our advantages to establish brand-loyalty with clients.Luoyang Golden Egret Geotools
Co., Ltd. established in 2012, is wholly-owned by listed company Xiamen Tungsten Co., Ltd (XTC).
Company registered capital is 1.05 billion Chinese Yuan, and first stage investment is one billion
Chinese Yuan. Company covers an area of 356,650 square meters, and it is the biggest production base
of cemented carbide products in China. Besides hard facing materials, Luoyang Golden Egret also
specializes in producing and selling high quality of mining drilling bits, carbide anvils, carbide
roll rings, and carbide substrates for PDC bits.Xiamen Tungsten Co., Ltd.(XTC) established in 1982,
and it is the biggest manufacturer and exporter of tungsten and molybdenum products in China. XTC
owns metal mines, smelting plants and production plants which constitute a complete industrial chain
to make our products more competitive in quality and price. As a national key Hi-Tech enterprise,
the mission of XTC is to develop and expand Chinese tungsten industry and new energy materials
industry. XTC is also a listed company on Shanghai Stock Exchange, and its market value is around 25
billion Chinese Yuan by end of 2020.

# Advanced tungsten carbide engineering, hard material innovations and precision tool solutions for
# global industrial applications

## **Our Solutions**

For over 100 years, we have been developing and producing sophisticated cutting tools and hard
material solutions: From highly specialized [cutting tools][8], indexable inserts and [carbide
rods][9] to new types of carbide and cermet grades for [wear protection][10] as well as wood and
stone working.

Through constant innovation, introspection and ingenuity we blaze the path to unrivalled quality,
only matched by our passion for 360° service and loyal, long-lasting partnerships.

[Read more][11]

## Know Your Product Carbon Footprint

Our goal is to establish a common standard on the market for calculating and classifying the carbon
footprint of cutting tools, hard material solutions and tungsten carbide powders. In this way, we
will be able to provide customers the carbon footprint transparency they require.

[Read more][12]

## Career at CERATIZIT

**Are you looking for a career that lets you build on your strengths?**

As one of the world's leading companies in carbide solutions and precision tools, we offer you a
diverse environment in which you and your passion for the industry can thrive.

[Read more][13]

## Corporate Culture and Values

At CERATIZIT, people come first. Guided by our values and driven by creativity, collaboration, and
integrity, we empower employees to innovate, share ideas, and shape a sustainable future together.
Join a culture where diversity thrives, decisions are fast, and passion fuels progress.

[Read more][14]

## Passion for Cemented Carbide

**Cemented carbide from CERATIZIT for high wear demands**

CERATIZIT manages the entire production process chain of cemented carbide and cemented carbide
components, from powder preparation to forming, sintering, finishing and surface treatment. The
blanks are subjected to grinding, polishing and EDM machining and are then given an innovative
wear-resistant coating, when necessary. This ensures that our carbide products have the properties
required for industrial applications.

[Read more][15]

# Advanced tungsten carbide engineering, hard material innovations and precision tool solutions for
# global industrial applications

## **Our Solutions**

For over 100 years, we have been developing and producing sophisticated cutting tools and hard
material solutions: From highly specialized [cutting tools][8], indexable inserts and [carbide
rods][9] to new types of carbide and cermet grades for [wear protection][10] as well as wood and
stone working.

Through constant innovation, introspection and ingenuity we blaze the path to unrivalled quality,
only matched by our passion for 360° service and loyal, long-lasting partnerships.

[Read more][11]

## Know Your Product Carbon Footprint

Our goal is to establish a common standard on the market for calculating and classifying the carbon
footprint of cutting tools, hard material solutions and tungsten carbide powders. In this way, we
will be able to provide customers the carbon footprint transparency they require.

[Read more][12]

## Career at CERATIZIT

**Are you looking for a career that lets you build on your strengths?**

As one of the world's leading companies in carbide solutions and precision tools, we offer you a
diverse environment in which you and your passion for the industry can thrive.

[Read more][13]

## Corporate Culture and Values

At CERATIZIT, people come first. Guided by our values and driven by creativity, collaboration, and
integrity, we empower employees to innovate, share ideas, and shape a sustainable future together.
Join a culture where diversity thrives, decisions are fast, and passion fuels progress.

[Read more][14]

## Passion for Cemented Carbide

**Cemented carbide from CERATIZIT for high wear demands**

CERATIZIT manages the entire production process chain of cemented carbide and cemented carbide
components, from powder preparation to forming, sintering, finishing and surface treatment. The
blanks are subjected to grinding, polishing and EDM machining and are then given an innovative
wear-resistant coating, when necessary. This ensures that our carbide products have the properties
required for industrial applications.

[Read more][15]

# H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders:
# Unser Know-how für Ihren Erfolg

Wir sind H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders, ein Unternehmen der Mitsubishi Materials Corporation. Seit
mehr als 100 Jahren entwickeln und produzieren wir für unsere Kunden hochwertige Pulver aus dem
Refraktärmetall Wolfram und dessen Verbindungen. Unser Produktspektrum reicht von Wolframaten bis zu
Wolframcarbiden in ultrafeinen bis groben Korngrößen. Sie alle entsprechen höchsten Ansprüchen an
Qualität und Leistungsfähigkeit. Dank der umfassenden Kompetenz unserer Teams in Chemie und
Metallurgie beschreiten wir auch innovative Wege, um für Sie die Lösung mit optimalem Mehrwert zu
entwickeln. Das heißt für unsere Kunden: Sie erhalten exakt das Pulver, das ihren individuellen
Anforderungen entspricht.

## Wir sind H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders

[DE innovativ] Innovativ Wir verbinden Erfahrung mit Innovationsgeist. Hochqualifizierte Teams in
Forschung & Entwicklung und in der Anwendungstechnik widmen sich den Lösungen von morgen. So
entwickeln wir in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden maßgeschneiderte Lösungen mit
herausragenden Materialeigenschaften. Nachhaltig Verlässlich [DE nachhaltig] Innovativ Nachhaltig
Verlässlich Nachhaltigkeit ist ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmensstrategie. Mithilfe einer
eigenen Technologie gewinnen wir den Großteil unseres Rohstoffs durch Recycling. Ergänzend dazu
haben wir über unseren Eigentümer Masan High-Tech Materials Zugriff auf konfliktfreien
Primärrohstoff. Die laufende Optimierung von Prozessen und Verfahren trägt dazu bei, den Verbrauch
von Energie und Hilfsstoffen zu optimieren.
Seit 2023 ist unser deutscher Standort nach EMAS zertifiziert. [DE verlässlich] Innovativ Nachhaltig
Verlässlich Versorgungssicherheit ist für unsere Kunden ein zentrales Thema. Wir haben Zugang zu
Primär- und Sekundärrohstoffen und sind damit unabhängig von Quellen beispielsweise in China.
Das macht uns zu einem verlässlichen Partner.

## Unsere Produkte für Ihre Branche

Wolfram ist dank seiner besonderen Eigenschaften in vielen Schlüsselindustrien unverzichtbar.
Verschaffen Sie sich einen Überblick der Branchen, in denen hochwertige, individuelle Wolframpulver
von H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders zur Anwendung kommen.

### [Maschinen- und Werkzeugbau][35]

Hochleistungswerkzeuge sind aus dem Maschinenbau nicht wegzudenken. Die kontinuierliche Steigerung
ihrer Präzision, in Kombination mit erhöhter Lebensdauer, ermöglicht den Anwendern ein optimiertes
Arbeiten. H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders liefert die dazu notwendigen hochreinen und
anwendungsspezifischen Wolframcarbidpulver.

[Icon | Maschinenbau | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Automobilindustrie][36]

Die Fertigungstechnologien im modernen Automobilbau erfordern hochleistungsfähige
Hartmetallwerkzeuge – beispielsweise für die Bearbeitung von Motorblöcken oder Bremsen. Unsere
hochwertigen Wolframcarbidpulver eignen sich optimal für die Herstellung von Werkzeugen zum Spanen,
Umformen und für die Metallbearbeitung allgemein.

[Icon | Automobilindustrie | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Luftfahrt][37]

Ausgerechnet in der Luftfahrt, wo sich alles um Leichtbau dreht, kommt eines der schwersten Metalle
überhaupt zum Einsatz: Wolfram oder Wolframlegierungen werden hier wegen ihrer hohen Dichte und
Festigkeit in Ausgleichsgewichten, Vibrationsschutzteilen für Ladeklappen oder zum Ausbalancieren
von Rotorblättern eingesetzt.

[Icon | Luft- und Raumfahrt | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Öl- und Gasbranche][38]

### [Öl- und Gasbranche][38]

H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders entwickelt und produziert Wolframpulver speziell für den Einsatz in der
Öl- und Gasexploration. Das Technologiemetall kommt nicht nur in Hochleistungsbohrköpfen zum
Einsatz, sondern auch in Hohlladungen, die das Gestein rund um ein Bohrloch perforieren, damit Öl
und Gas abfließen können.

[Icon | Öl- und Gasexploration | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Chemische Industrie][39]

In der chemischen Industrie gibt es vielfältige Möglichkeiten Wolfram anzuwenden, insbesondere im
Bereich der Katalysatoren, wie zum Beispiel Oxidationskatalysatoren. Und wir verstehen es, die
passenden Wolframchemikalien herzustellen.

[Icon | Chemische Industrie | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Medizintechnik][40]

Die Medizintechnik nutzt Wolfram, um Geräte leistungsfähiger und schonender zu machen.
Präzisionsbauteile aus Wolframmetall werden beispielsweise in der modernen Röntgendiagnostik und
-therapie eingesetzt, um harte Röntgen- oder Gammastrahlung abzuschirmen und zu fokussieren.

[Medizintechnik | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Elektroindustrie][41]

Eine hohe thermische Belastbarkeit von Wolfram-Kupfer-Werkstoffen in Kombination mit sehr guten
Wärme- und guten elektrischen Leitfähigkeiten prädestinieren diese Materialien für Anwendungen in
elektrischen Hochleistungsschaltkontakten, als Wärmesenken in der Elektroindustrie oder zum Einsatz
als Erodierelektroden.

[Icon | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

optimale Pulvermischung – sprechen Sie uns an!

At Oerlikon, we engineer innovative technologies and solutions that make our customers' products
last longer, perform better, and generate less waste. Our high-tech surface solutions and advanced
materials are designed for applications in the most demanding industries.

services, and component manufacturing. Our global network of highly skilled engineers and problem
solvers is combined with a strong local presence, ensuring we are always close to our customers.

Oerlikon at the bottom of the sea

pumps and seals against pressure, corrosion and wear. This increases reliability, lowers costs and
helps protect sensitive underwater environments.

Taking off safely and efficiently

more economical. Our coatings, superalloy components and 3D printed parts protect metal alloys
against extreme heat and loads, supporting the next generation of sustainable aviation.

[ Read the full story ][93]

High performance for high performance

industry with coatings, thermal interface materials and 3D printed components that protect chip
production equipment, improve heat management and help manufacturers push the limits of performance.

[ Read the full story ][94]
4

sustainable. Our technologies protect battery systems, reduce weight, lower friction and improve
manufacturing efficiency, helping both drivers and manufacturers.

# Hannecard - ASB: Innovative Industrial Coating Services

Our coating services can dramatically improve your equipment’s performance and extend its working
life. We offer turnkey thermal spray and cold spray coatings, as well as secondary services like
welding, machining, and grinding, to give our customers finished, ready-to-use treated parts.

With decades of experience in identifying the causes of wear, we can adapt our thermal spray and
cold spray surfacing technologies to best address the needs of your application.

## First-Class Industrial Coating Services

With advanced equipment, a skilled staff of thermal sprayers and machinists, and extensive machining
and grinding capabilities, Hannecard - ASB can provide unique **[thermal spray][79]** and **[cold
spray][80]** solutions for extreme wear, high-temperature barriers, and all-encompassing part
repair.

Our in-house, turnkey industrial coating services will give your equipment extended service life by
meeting or exceeding original equipment designs. **[Submit your project][81]** or **[contact
us][82]** today!

industry. We work hard to create customized thermal spray and cold spray solutions for your unique
challenges. Our thermal spray/cold spray [capabilities][84] include:
* [HVOF Coatings][85]
* [Flame Spray Coatings][86]
* [Hard Coating Surfacing][87]
* [Roll Coatings][88]
* [Plasma Electric Arc Spray][89]
* [Plasma Transferred Arc Welding][90]
* [Electric Arc Spray][91]

Because our industrial coating services are custom specified to your project, you can count on
superior protection for and exceptional performance from your coated components. We will work with
you to develop and outline procedures to match your defined specifications.

## Multimetal, now MM1018 - the first metal-polymer with building authority approval

Multimetal, our “liquid backing plate”, comes with polymer bonding which totallytransforms gap
compensation. This ensures your assembly process becomes quicker and safer, while also reducing
costs!

When you’re working on complex activities such as constructing a bridge or even a wind power plant,
multimetal is appropriate to use as it makes sure unevenness and imperfect flange connections are
taken care of.

There are a number of other advantages of using the tried-and-tested multimetal MM1018. It not only
helps save time and expenses, it is resistant to weather changes and chemical spillage. It is also
resistant to any pressure put on it and can become fully resilient in short period of time. It also
comes with general building authority approval.

## Seal and seal microporous metal with capillary action? seal!

When coatings are being treated using thermal spraying in a capillary-active manner, there are
always cracks, which need to be sealed. We manufacture dichtol, which is a 1-component polymer
system, to make sure metal can be sealed reliably. You can use dichtol for any kind of pores,
ranging from the smallest to the largest.

However, dichtol need not be used only in case of a crack. Instead, you can even use it as a
preventative measure. dichtol can permeate even the tiniest metal opening, so you can use it as
sealant without having to resort to mechanical or thermal stress.

# A Lifetime Of Experience in Protective Coatings Your Trusted Coating Specialist in Pearland, TX

With decades of experience, Gartner Coatings is an established leader in industrial and
architectural coatings, proudly serving the Houston area. As protective coatings specialists, we
provide high-quality solutions for metal, aluminum, and industrial surfaces, ensuring superior
corrosion resistance and durability. Whether you need Valspar Industrial Coatings, metalized
coatings, or specialized coatings, we tailor our services to meet your needs.

## Comprehensive Coating Solutions

At Gartner Coatings, we deliver industrial coatings solutions that meet and exceed customer
expectations. Our team is highly trained and equipped with state-of-the-art technology to provide
high-performance coatings across various industries. As coating specialists, we strive to be the
trusted partner for businesses needing metalizing solutions, architectural aluminum, tank lining
solutions, and custom coatings.

### Metalizing Services

As a premier metalized coatings company, we provide thermal spray coating services engineered for
long-term corrosion protection. Our industrial coating specialists use twin arc spray and flame
spray coating methods to coat steel, aluminum, and concrete structures, including valves, heat
exchangers, process vessels, and ISO tanks. These processes enhance surface protection against
moisture, chemicals, and extreme environments.

[Learn More][3]

### Architectural Coatings

Gartner Coatings offers a full range of aluminum finishing services, each formulated with 70% Kynar
resin for unmatched weather resistance. As a certified applicator of Valspar Industrial Coatings on
architectural aluminum, we provide in-house color-matching services to improve lead time, and they
meet AAMA 2603 and AAMA 2605 standards. These architectural coatings resist dirt pickup, chalking,
fading and UV degradation.

[Learn More][4]

### Tank Lining & Coating Services

With over 75 years of expertise, Gartner Coatings is the protective coating specialist you can trust
for specialized tank lining services. As the leader in coating ISO tank containers and OTR trailers
for chemical and food-grade services, we provide the right lining on time, every time.

[Learn More][5]

### Other Services

Beyond corrosion protection, Gartner Coatings offers specialty coatings, liquid coatings, and
blasting services for various applications.

[Learn More][6]

It’s not our first day – we’ve been leading the way with unmatched precision for nearly 100 years.
Gartner Coatings is strategically located on 10 acres in Pearland, TX, just 15 miles south of
downtown Houston. Our 26,000 square feet of covered space is built to handle projects of all sizes
with a commitment to quality, efficiency, and innovation.

We are fully equipped to provide expert coating application services with two indoor blast booths, a
large metalizing chamber, four large paint booths, four industrial heaters, and a temperature and
humidity-controlled inventory storage. When the job requires specialized solutions, Gartner Coatings
can take the heat.

About Us

Luoyang Golden Egret Geotools Co., Ltd. is a global leading hard facing materials manufacturer which
supplies various surfacing materials include thermal spray powders, thermal [Spray Wires][124],
laser cladding powders, PTA welding powders, tungsten carbide welding rods and ropes. Products have
been delivered to more than thirty countries, and we keep a strategic & long-term partnership with
some famous enterprises in Europe and United States through OEM business. Luoyang Golden Egret
manufactures materials serve industries such as oil & gas, steel, pape, plastic, power generation,
aviation, and mining etc.
Stable & premium quality, in-time customer service, and best technical support are our advantages to
establish brand-loyalty with clients.

Luoyang Golden Egret Geotools Co., Ltd. established in 2012, is wholly-owned by listed company
Xiamen Tungsten Co., Ltd (XTC). Company registered capital is 1.05 billion Chinese Yuan, and first
stage investment is one billion Chinese Yuan. Company covers an area of 356,650 square meters, and
it is the biggest production base of cemented carbide products in China. Besides hard facing
materials, Luoyang Golden Egret also specializes in producing and selling high quality of mining
drilling bits, carbide anvils, carbide roll rings, and carbide substrates for PDC bits.


Xiamen Tungsten Co., Ltd.(XTC) established in 1982, and it is the biggest manufacturer and exporter
of tungsten and molybdenum products in China. XTC owns metal mines, smelting plants and production
plants which constitute a complete industrial chain to make our products more competitive in quality
and price. As a national key Hi-Tech enterprise, the mission of XTC is to develop and expand Chinese
tungsten industry and new energy materials industry.
XTC is also a listed company on Shanghai Stock Exchange, and its market value is around 25 billion
Chinese Yuan by end of 2020.

down sheets or CNC routed profiles. [Optical Coatings][133] is the UK and Ireland stockholder and

chamber and have a purity of 99.99%.

# Longevity Coatings Corp

## **Bringing New Efficiencies to Today’s Thermal Spray Coatings Industry.**

## **We specialize in coatings**

Carbides, metals, ceramics, and abradable thermal spray coatings, as well as dimensional restoration
coatings. No job is too small, too large or too complex. Longevity has the [materials][39] and
coating application process that will meet your needs in the most cost-effective way.

[Tungsten Carbide Coatings][40]
[Oxide Ceramic Coatings][41]
[Dimensional restoration][42]

## **THERMAL SPRAY COATING SERVICES**

Carbide, ceramic, and many other materials to industrial parts and products. Utilizing processes
including HVAF, HVOF, Plasma, twin wire arc and diffusion bonding. Learn More at the process pages
below.

[HVOF coatings][43]
[HVAF coatings][44]
[Plasma coatings][45]
[Twin arc coatings][46]
[Fused coatings][47]

### **What thermal spray coatings can do for you**
* **Enhance Durability:** Protect surfaces from wear, abrasion, and corrosion, extending component
  lifespan.
* **Improve Performance:** Optimize thermal, electrical, or chemical resistance for demanding
  applications.
* **Reduce Maintenance Costs:** Minimize downtime and repair expenses with robust, long-lasting
  coatings.
* **Increase Efficiency:** Enhance surface properties like lubricity or heat resistance to boost
  operational efficiency.
* **Enable Customization:** Tailor coatings to specific needs, such as high-temperature or non-stick
  properties.
* **Protect Against Harsh Environments:** Shield components from extreme temperatures, chemicals, or
  erosion.
* **Restore Worn Parts:** Rebuild and repair damaged surfaces, saving on replacement costs.

## **FULL-SERVICE MANUFACTURING/MACHINING**

Manufacturing of complete components, including CNC milling, turning, diamond grinding, Lapping and
solid ceramic, and carbide structures. Longevity coatings offers one stop manufacturing for
components that require spray coatings and final machining.

[Manufacturing Capabilities][48]

## Why Choose Longevity Coatings

Longevity Coatings has for decades provided quality thermal spray coatings to industry. With
industry knowledge dating back generations, We pride ourselves on producing the best possible spray
coating solution every time. Longevity has the equipment, knowledge, and facilities to provide the
best in surface coating solutions.

#### We can provide
* **Unmatched Expertise:** Decades of experience delivering precision thermal spray coatings for
  diverse industries.
* **Superior Quality:** Advanced coating technologies ensure exceptional durability, performance,
  and reliability.
* **Customized Solutions:** Tailored coatings to meet your specific needs, from wear resistance to
  thermal protection.
* **Cutting-Edge Technology:** State-of-the-art equipment and processes for consistent, high-quality
  results.
* **Fast Turnaround:** Efficient processes to minimize downtime and keep your operations running
  smoothly.

the mission of XTC is to develop and expand Chinese tungsten industry and new energy materials

# A Trusted Provider of Thermal Spray Products and More

If you need it for your Thermal Spray Coating business, we’ve got it. For more than a decade
McLaughlin & Associates has provided quality products and services for all aspects of the thermal
spray coatings industry.

## We Help Your

## Business Succeed.

McLaughlin & Associates is committed to providing customers with affordable and dependable thermal
spray solutions to solve and exceed expectations. We're industry experts on thermal spray products,
machinery, systems, and consumables, including powder, wire, and more. But it doesn't stop there; we
are committed to helping you along the way. We provide expert consulting to ensure you find the
right products and services. We work hard to help you create a distinct performance advantage with
exceptional value in all we do!

[ More About Our Products ][27]

oil & gas, aerospace, and industrial sectors with high-quality, cost-effective component repair and
surface treatment solutions.

###### Precision. Quality. Innovation. Trust

Send your worn or damaged parts to PMMT, and we’ll restore them to like-new condition. Leveraging
our expertise in precision machining and advanced coating technologies, we carefully analyze each
component to determine the optimal restoration process, ensuring enhanced durability, improved
performance, and cost-effective refurbishment. Trust PMMT to breathe new life into your parts,
maximizing efficiency while minimizing waste.

Located in [Manchester, CT][19], Our mission is to deliver components of the highest quality with
unparalleled attention to detail and responsive service.

[ Contact Us ][20]
[ View Product List ][21]

Since 1998, Technical Engineering, LLC has specialized in precision CNC turning, CNC Milling (3,4, &
5-axis) and the latest in Computer Aided Design and Manufacturing (CAD/CAM).

We've had the pleasure of serving the Thermal Spray and Ground Turbine Engine industries and are
recognized for the design and production of high quality parts and components including thermal
spray parts and tooling.

Our product lines include in-house designed and manufactured thermal spray guns and replacement
parts for the thermal spray industry, specifically the JET KOTE®¹ system, Gator-Gard® system, JP5000
system, and F4 system. We hold patents on a modular F4 Gun, our own Combustion Head for use in a JET
KOTE®¹  system, and several other patents pending.



Utilizing the latest in manufacturing technologies, our mission is to deliver components of the
highest quality with unparalleled attention to detail and responsive service.



In 2017 we earned our ISO9001 Certification and are proud to announce our AS9100D Certification as
of 2022.

What sets Thermal Spray Depot apart is not just the service or products we offer; it’s the rich
tapestry of expertise woven throughout our history. My own journey in metallurgy and over three
decades in the coating industry have been pivotal in shaping a deep, multidimensional grasp of
thermal spray technology. From the analytical rigor of lab work to the frontline challenges of
ensuring quality and profitability in coatings, my path reflects the core ethos of Thermal Spray
Depot: an unyielding commitment to excellence and innovation.

## **A Symphony of Collaboration**

At the heart of Thermal Spray Depot’s philosophy is a vibrant spirit of collaboration. We’ve built
robust partnerships with over a dozen companies, which means we don’t just sell; we advise, tailor,
and fine-tune solutions that align precisely with our customers’ needs. It’s this alliance with both
suppliers and seasoned engineers that empowers us to provide insights and solutions that truly make
a difference.

## **Empowerment through In-House Capability**

A pivotal moment for many of our clients is the decision to internalize their coating processes. The
promise of tighter control over schedules and costs is a compelling one. Thermal Spray Depot is at
the forefront of this movement, offering not just equipment and materials, but a blueprint for
success, complete with training and ongoing support.

## **Automation: The Future Is Now**

Recognizing the critical role of automation in production efficiency, Thermal Spray Depot remains at
the cutting edge, integrating standard robots and PLC controllers to deliver maintainable and
cost-effective automation solutions. Our approach is designed to give clients ownership over their
systems, liberating them from the constraints of proprietary software and exclusive support.

## **ROI: The Bottom Line**

the critical variables to showcase a clear financial picture of in-house coating operations. We even
navigate leasing options to accommodate diverse financial capabilities.

What sets Thermal Spray Depot apart is not just the service or products we offer; it’s the rich
tapestry of expertise woven throughout our history. My own journey in metallurgy and over three
decades in the coating industry have been pivotal in shaping a deep, multidimensional grasp of
thermal spray technology. From the analytical rigor of lab work to the frontline challenges of
ensuring quality and profitability in coatings, my path reflects the core ethos of Thermal Spray
Depot: an unyielding commitment to excellence and innovation.

robust partnerships with over a dozen companies, which means we don’t just sell; we advise, tailor,
and fine-tune solutions that align precisely with our customers’ needs. It’s this alliance with both
suppliers and seasoned engineers that empowers us to provide insights and solutions that truly make
a difference.

## **Empowerment through In-House Capability**

promise of tighter control over schedules and costs is a compelling one. Thermal Spray Depot is at
the forefront of this movement, offering not just equipment and materials, but a blueprint for
success, complete with training and ongoing support.

the cutting edge, integrating standard robots and PLC controllers to deliver maintainable and
cost-effective automation solutions. Our approach is designed to give clients ownership over their
systems, liberating them from the constraints of proprietary software and exclusive support.

high-performance coatings for various products and equipment. Numerous industries rely on our

can keep up with your demands using state-of-the-art technology while delivering consistent results

  surface for coating.

  material is deposited on parts susceptible to corrosion and erosion. We use automated spray
  equipment to produce this layer of protection, increasing a product’s lifespan while protecting
  its components.
* **Cold spray**: Also known as supersonic particle deposition, this high-energy metal coating spray
  solution uses a heated high-pressure carrier gas to deposit or accelerate metal powders through a
  supersonic nozzle to facilitate particle adhesion.
* **Flame spray**: Using a heat source to melt powder or wire form into a sprayable coating, flame
  spray can metalize a substrate for superior protection on surfaces against innumerable
  environmental conditions while reducing the need for constant maintenance.

ABOUT US

Luoyang Golden Egret Geotools Co., Ltd.

Luoyang Golden Egret Geotools Co., Ltd. is a global leading hard facing materials manufacturer which
supplies various surfacing materials include thermal spray powders, thermal [Spray Wires][75], laser
cladding powders, PTA welding powders, tungsten carbide welding rods and ropes. Products have been
delivered to more than thirty countries, and we keep a strategic & long-term partnership with some
famous enterprises in Europe and United States through OEM business. Luoyang Golden Egret
manufactures materials serve industries such as oil & gas, steel, pape, plastic, power generation,
aviation, and mining etc. Stable & premium quality, in-time customer service, and best technical
support are our advantages to establish brand-loyalty with clients.Luoyang Golden Egret Geotools
Co., Ltd. established in 2012, is wholly-owned by listed company Xiamen Tungsten Co., Ltd (XTC).
Company registered capital is 1.05 billion Chinese Yuan, and first stage investment is one billion
Chinese Yuan. Company covers an area of 356,650 square meters, and it is the biggest production base
of cemented carbide products in China. Besides hard facing materials, Luoyang Golden Egret also
specializes in producing and selling high quality of mining drilling bits, carbide anvils, carbide
roll rings, and carbide substrates for PDC bits.Xiamen Tungsten Co., Ltd.(XTC) established in 1982,
and it is the biggest manufacturer and exporter of tungsten and molybdenum products in China. XTC
owns metal mines, smelting plants and production plants which constitute a complete industrial chain
to make our products more competitive in quality and price. As a national key Hi-Tech enterprise,
the mission of XTC is to develop and expand Chinese tungsten industry and new energy materials
industry. XTC is also a listed company on Shanghai Stock Exchange, and its market value is around 25
billion Chinese Yuan by end of 2020.
